headline: STL @ KCR matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is STL 4.58 at KCR 4.74, with a projected total of 9.32. NRFI probability dropped -6.1%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Seth Lugo has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.4 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Carter Jensen, Bobby Witt Jr., Alec Burleson, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production.
